The configuration one call runs under.

The library preset is beaten by the record, and the record by this call's flat mirrors — unless wins says otherwise. A flat mirror that contradicts the record beside it is what clash arbitrates: taken silently by wins, refused, or handed to the caller's function as (the record, the two as one).
